subject: CSEC Mathematics
subtopic: Estimating the median from a cumulative frequency table
question: Sixty candidates sat a test. The cumulative frequencies are 5, 18, 38, 52 and 60 at the upper class boundaries 10.5, 20.5, 30.5, 40.5 and 50.5 marks. An estimate of the MEDIAN mark is
stem: Sixty candidates sat a test. The cumulative frequencies are 5, 18, 38, 52 and 60 at the upper class boundaries 10.5, 20.5, 30.5, 40.5 and 50.5 marks. An estimate of the MEDIAN mark is

misconception.label: Took the middle of the class without interpolating.
misconception.remediation_hint: Took the middle of the class without interpolating.

misconception.label: Gave the position of the median rather than the mark.
misconception.remediation_hint: Gave the position of the median rather than the mark.

misconception.label: Gave the class boundary rather than the interpolated value.
misconception.remediation_hint: Gave the class boundary rather than the interpolated value.

worked_solution: The median is the 30th value, since 60/2 = 30.. 30 lies between the cumulative frequencies 18 (at 20.5) and 38 (at 30.5).. Median = 20.5 + [(30 - 18)/(38 - 18)] x 10. = 20.5 + 6 = 26.5 marks.
